card.name: Words just before monitoring or checking
card.fires_on: Small words like "of", "be", "increased" or "checked" that sit right before a word such as monitoring, monitored or frequently. Seen in label advice to watch a patient or lab value more often.

modes.label: Frequency of monitoring
modes.description: Words like "of" or "increased" leading into monitoring terms such as INR or blood glucose monitoring.
